== Ingredients ==
* 1 boneless [[Cookbook:Pork#Loin|pork loin]] roast
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Apple Stuffing|Apple Stuffing]]
* [[Cookbook:Grill Seasoning|Grill Seasoning for Chops]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]]

== Procedure ==
#Make a slit in the top center of the roast about 1¼ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] deep. Fill with Apple Stuffing. Brush opening with Dijon mustard, and press closed. 
#Brush roast with olive oil and liberally shake on grill seasoning. Set aside until needed.
#Grill on a preheated charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]], turning often, until internal temperature reaches 140°F.
#Remove and let rest 7 minutes. Serve.
